title: Fantasy RPG for mobile driven by real world activity
author: tr99house123
selftext:
Heya, I used to be an avid gamer but life happens and time is spent for other things. Thirst is still there so I am making a mobile game which respects your time and rewards you for living well. 

Art style is inspired by Black Desert Online, Elder Scrolls Online etc. instead of pixel or cutesy graphics.

Instead of being like Pokemon Go where you need to check your phone while walking, Stridera lets you focus on being present in real time and reap the rewards of your activity later. 

It converts calories burned IRL into energy which you use to explore and eventually restore a spiritually hollow world.

I am attaching a video of the world map and first playable biome Verdant Reach. 

Game is nearing “vertical slice” play test. 

Curious to hear your thoughts on game concept. Do you prefer Pokemon Go style - looking at the phone while outside or something like this?

Thanks in advance for your responses.

AI is used for coding help and image generation.

comments.author: tr99house123
comments.body: If you wish to learn more https://playstridera.com/

comments.author: Aineisa
comments.body:
Really neat concept!

You should use steps walked as well. 

Would be interesting if you could flag certain locations as fantasy locations. Your work could be a dungeon. Your home a village. And then use that as part of the gameplay.

replies.author: tr99house123
replies.body:
Hey, thanks 💪 I thought about adding steps but decided against it for now since people who cycle/swim/go to gym can’t benefit from it. 

Your idea is interesting! Food for thought for sure.

comments.author: JonFawkes
comments.body: Kinda neat, looking forward to seeing how the different gameplay elements work. I played Orna for a while, and right now I'm enjoying MegaMan Advanced PET (another AI assisted game) for turning real world activity into game activity. I like gamified exercise, its my best motivation to do it. Hopefully you have a lot of depth in your gameplay, I got bored of grinding in Orna after a while

replies.author: tr99house123
replies.body: Depth is exactly what I am going for. I want something that rewards journey rather than excessive grind/repetition. Appreciate the kind words :)
